name: Mage
playstyle: Ranged Caster / AoE Kiter — Frostfire Bolt, Arcane Blast/Ice Lance tuning, Scroll Deciphering utility, strafe-kiting

base_bar1.PAD1 (B): Primary Nuke (Frostbolt / Fireball / Frostfire Bolt / Arcane Blast)
base_bar1.PAD2 (A): Instant Cast (Fire Blast / Ice Lance / Arcane Missiles)
base_bar1.PAD3 (Y): AoE Cone / Burst (Cone of Cold / Blast Wave / Arcane Explosion)

macros.name: PW_MAG_CS
macros.description: Cancels current spell cast and fires Counterspell immediately

macros.name: PW_MAG_BLK
macros.description: Cancels current cast and Blinks immediately out of danger or stuns

macros.name: PW_MAG_IB
macros.description: Enters Ice Block (canceling current cast); press again to cancel aura
macros.body:
#showtooltip Ice Block
/stopcasting
/cancelaura Ice Block
/cast Ice Block

macros.name: PW_MAG_POLY
macros.description: Casts Polymorph on mouseover or current hostile target

consolePortNotes: GamePadFaceMovementMaxAngle=115 is essential for Frost Nova -> strafe -> Cone of Cold kiting without spinning your camera. Put Teleports/Portals and Conjure spells in a ConsolePort Utility Ring.
